text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—The race is finally entering its climax!! 
In the Japan Cup at Tokyo Racecourse this 
autumn, which Umamusume will claim the 
title of the strongest?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I can't lose... I won't back down!! Not 
right here! Not right now!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Kita-san is so strong!! Crown-san and 
Earth-san too... But still!!)

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
It's Cheval Grand, Cheval Grand! In the 
lead is Cheval Grand, and just like that— 
she crosses the finish line!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand takes 1st!! Overcoming a 
stellar generation and the world's best, 
she seizes the moment now!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And claiming a magnificent victory in the 
Japan Cup is Cheval Grand! It's Cheval 
Grand!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Cheval! Cheval! Cheval! Cheval! Cheval! 
Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
"Well done...! You did it, Cheval 
Grandーーー!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
"You were so strong! And so cool!! Out of 
everyone here today—"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Fan
text_block_list.text:
You're number one! That was a magnificent 
run, Cheval!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Cheval! Cheval! Cheval! Cheval! Cheval! 
Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cheval Grand roared toward the azure sky. 
It was a powerful, resounding cry that 
couldn't be drowned out even by the 
massive crowd.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(That's right, I did it! I really did it! 
I pulled it off! So—!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (You can do it too! Go for it...!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(I'll keep shouting to you that you're 
going to be okay!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even if we're weak, even if we're tiny, 
even if sometimes we completely hate 
ourselves!!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(It's okay, you're allowed to wish, to 
move forward, and to reach out for your 
dreams— I'll keep shouting it to you, 
forever!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hurriedly ran over and somehow managed 
to catch her burning-hot body, which had 
poured out every last drop of strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even as she was carried off the track in 
my arms, Cheval Grand was showered with 
relentless applause and cheers the entire 
way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Forever and ever. Resonating so far that 
it felt like it would echo to the ends of 
the earth—

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
"...Mom. Could you let me talk with the 
teacher?"

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Reaching out toward my dream. I won't give 
up, either.

text_block_list.name: Shine Praise
text_block_list.text:
Because a "great Umamusume" gave me 
courage!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Asked to pose by the reporters in the 
winner's circle, Cheval Grand managed an 
awkward smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The timid, downcast 'Great Umamusume' 
taught the world how to embrace courage."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Cheval Grand's Japan Cup came to a 
close with a spectacular victory—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Um, has there been... a phone call yet?
choice_data_list: Doesn't look like it yet, huh...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
S-Shouldn't it be going off any second 
now!?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……Aargh, the phone! I-Is it broken?! Like, 
did the line get cut or something……?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand your anxiety, but rushing 
won't make it finish any faster... Or so I 
was about to tell them, when—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
How... did it go...? Shine's surgery... 
what were the results?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Chevalier Grand looking tense, I 
frankly relay what I had just heard over 
the phone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shine Praise bravely undertook the 
extremely difficult surgery, but—
choice_data_list: They said the surgery was a success!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: Shine will be able to run again!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: Thank goodness...! I'm so glad, Cheval!
Thank goodness...! I'm so glad, Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Just for today, let's take a break from 
being 'strong' and 'great.'

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I gently rubbed her back again and again 
as she sobbed like a little child.
